name: Mem0
ontology_notes: No companion kinds (user bio, character autobiography, relationship state, lore, OOC). Stored unit is a free-text memory plus metadata. Scopes are user_id, agent_id, run_id, app_id. Platform tags with categories (default catalog includes personal_details, family, user_preferences, misc). MemoryType enum defines procedural_memory, semantic_memory, episodic_memory; only procedural_memory is implemented in Python OSS and requires agent_id. Platform Graph Memory stores named entities as graph nodes, not companion roles.

ontology.evidence: docs.mem0.ai/core-concepts/memory-types.md states only procedural_memory is wired; semantic_memory and episodic_memory are rejected. Other memories are identifier-scoped facts plus optional categories from platform/features/custom-categories.md.
ontology.label: measured

write_policy.evidence: add() with infer=True (default) runs LLM extraction; infer=False stores raw text. App code, MCP add_memory, and custom_instructions steer what is stored. How-it-works.md says Mem0 extracts facts, not a verbatim transcript, unless infer is off.
write_policy.label: measured

read_policy.evidence: how-it-works.md says the app calls search before the next model request and decides which hits to put in the prompt. search.md ranks by semantic, keyword, entity, and (Platform) temporal signals, scoped by filters. Empty results mean nothing is injected unless the app adds other context.
read_policy.label: measured

supersession.evidence: mem0/memory/main.py _add_to_vector_store uses ADDITIVE_EXTRACTION_PROMPT and emits event ADD only. Platform Dream supersede/merge (dream.md) marks old facts without deleting them; latest_only=true hides superseded rows. Explicit update() and delete() remain. OSS has no Dream pipeline.
supersession.label: measured

temporal.evidence: Platform temporal-reasoning.md boosts memories whose event dates match query time (yesterday, last week, reference_date). add() accepts expiration_date. OSS search has no temporal-reasoning page; evaluation.md says the temporal pass is a Platform extraction stage.
temporal.label: measured

identity_split.evidence: entity-scoped-memory.md partitions by user_id, agent_id, app_id, run_id. Default extraction attributes a fact to the speaker, so a record gets user_id or agent_id, not both. There is no first-class character vs relationship vs lore type.
identity_split.label: measured

silence.evidence: search.md and MCP tool list expose ranking and filters (user, category, date). No control to skip a high-similarity hit for social reasons (trauma, kink, spoilers, jokes).
silence.label: measured

poisoning.evidence: ADDITIVE_EXTRACTION_PROMPT in mem0/configs/prompts.py extracts from user and assistant messages into retrievable facts. how-it-works.md warns against storing secrets but documents no provenance, trust tags, or jailbreak filter on stored text.
poisoning.label: measured

forgetting.evidence: delete.md documents delete, batch_delete, and delete_all by user/agent/run, including GDPR-style erasure. expiration_date hides expired rows from search. memory-decay.md is search-time ranking, not deletion.
forgetting.label: measured

cost_shape.evidence: evaluation.md: extraction is one LLM pass plus embedding; Platform adds an async temporal pass. Retrieval is vector/keyword/entity fusion without an extra LLM unless a reranker is on. Claimed mean tokens per query about 6956 on LoCoMo at top_200. The companion app still pays one search inject per turn.
cost_shape.label: measured

local.evidence: OSS Memory class in mem0ai/mem0 is Apache-2.0. docs.mem0.ai/components/llms/models/ollama.md and cookbooks/companions/local-companion-ollama exist. Intimate chat can stay on one machine if the operator supplies a local LLM and embedder. Platform MCP stores memories in the Mem0 account.
local.label: measured

mcp.evidence: platform/mem0-mcp.md documents the hosted server at https://mcp.mem0.ai/mcp with add_memory, search_memories, update_memory, delete_memory, and related tools. Requires a Platform account.
mcp.label: measured

companion_fit_reason: Cookbooks target AI companions, and Platform Dream/temporal help with stale facts, but the store is a user_id bag of extracted sentences. No character vs relationship vs lore types, no silence, no poisoning filter. The documented loop is extract then search then prompt, which is the shared retrieve-equals-remember premise. OSS lacks Dream and temporal reasoning.

published_eval.name: LoCoMo, LongMemEval, BEAM
published_eval.claimed_score: LoCoMo overall 92.5 (mean 6956 tokens); LongMemEval overall 94.4 (mean 6787 tokens); BEAM 1M 64.1 / 10M 48.6 (mean ~6700-6900 tokens). Platform only. top_200. +/- 1 judge CI.
published_eval.what_it_actually_scores: Fact and preference QA over assistant-style multi-session chat (single-hop, multi-hop, temporal, knowledge update). Does not score character identity drift, socially wrong recall, joke-as-fact, cross-character leak, or persona jailbreaks.

open_unknowns: Whether Platform closed-source extraction still uses a hidden UPDATE/DELETE path besides documented Dream supersede/merge.
Whether OSS Python still has any caller of DEFAULT_UPDATE_MEMORY_PROMPT (the string remains in prompts.py; main.py add path does not import it).
